PS2 ONLINE - play a PS2 game's own multiplayer with friends over the internet
============================================================================

What it does: games that let 2-4 people play on ONE PS2 (several controllers, or a multitap) can be played
by friends at different homes. Every PC runs the real game; only the button presses travel over the internet,
so every PC shows the same screen. The game is not changed.

EVERY PLAYER NEEDS THE SAME GAME FILE (same version, e.g. USA) on their own PC, and the same PS2 BIOS.

!! "MY-GAMES (never share)" and "emulator\bios" contain YOUR games and YOUR PS2 BIOS.
!! Use them only on your own PCs. Do not upload them or give them to other people.
!! Friends must use their own copy of the game and their own BIOS (SCPH-90001).

Tested so far: Digimon Rumble Arena 2 (USA), 4 players. Other games: see "OTHER GAMES" below.
Digimon Rumble Arena 2 (USA): all characters are unlocked (file emulator\patches\SLUS-21067_568A5C78.pnach).

------------------------------------------------------------------
FIRST TIME ON A PC
------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Copy the whole PS2-ONLINE folder to the PC, for example to the Desktop. Do not run it from a USB stick.
2. Put your game file(s) (.iso, .chd, .cso or .cue) into "MY-GAMES (never share)".
3. Double-click START-PS2-ONLINE.bat. The "PS2 Online" window opens.
4. Windows may ask about the firewall (for "pcsx2-qtx64" and "ps2net-link").
   Tick BOTH boxes, "Private networks" AND "Public networks", then click Allow.
   (Clicked the wrong thing? Windows Security > Firewall > Allow an app.)
5. Controls work at once, no setup needed:
   - Gamepad (Xbox, PlayStation and most others): plug it in BEFORE starting. A = Cross, B = Circle,
     X = Square, Y = Triangle, Back/Select = Select. (PlayStation pads: the same buttons as on a PS2.)
   - Keyboard: arrows or WASD = move, K = Cross, L = Circle, J = Square, I = Triangle, Enter = Start,
     Backspace = Select, Q/E = L1/R1, 1/3 = L2/R2.
   Only if your pad does nothing: button "Controller settings" > Settings > Controllers > Controller Port 1.

------------------------------------------------------------------
PLAYING
------------------------------------------------------------------
HOST (player 1):
  1. Choose the Game, the Controllers layout (see below), the Screen and the number of players.
     Press "Host a game".
  2. A JOIN CODE appears (PSN1-...) and is already copied. Paste it into the chat with your friends.
     The code also tells the friends' PCs which game, controllers and screen you chose.
  3. The game window opens and waits ("Players: 1 of 2. Waiting...").

FRIEND:
  1. Copy the join code from the chat, paste it into box 2, press "Join". Your PC picks the same game file
     automatically (you must have it in "MY-GAMES (never share)").
  2. Wait about 10 seconds. The game window opens and says "Connected to the host".
  3. If it does NOT connect: the window shows a REPLY CODE (PSR1-...), already copied.
     Send it to the host. The host pastes it into "paste a friend's reply code" and presses "Add reply".

SAME HOUSE: the host presses "Host a game" as usual. The friend chooses the SAME game, controllers and screen,
types the host's IP address (host PC: open "cmd", type ipconfig, see "IPv4 Address", e.g. 192.168.1.20)
into box 3 and presses "Join by IP".

When everyone is connected, the game starts on every PC at the same time, from the PS2 start screen.
Full screen: Alt+Enter. Pause menu: Esc (everyone waits while one player is paused).

------------------------------------------------------------------
SCREEN AND PICTURE
------------------------------------------------------------------
- Screen (chosen by the HOST, the same for everybody, because it changes the game's camera):
  "Widescreen 16:9" fills a normal modern monitor. It works if the game has a widescreen patch
  (Digimon Rumble Arena 2 has one; PCSX2's patch collection has them for many games). Otherwise "Normal 4:3".
- Picture (every PC chooses its OWN, it does not change the game): "Auto" picks the best sharpness for
  this PC's graphics card that still runs at full speed (for example RTX 5090 = 8x, RTX 3060 = 4x,
  laptop graphics = 2x). If the game is slow or stutters on your PC, choose a lower Picture.
  The FPS counter in the corner of the game window should show 60 (59-60).
- Full screen: tick "Full screen" (or press Alt+Enter in the game).
- Connection (chosen by the HOST): "Smooth" (recommended) adds a small safety buffer on internet connections,
  so short internet hiccups do not pause the game (buttons react about 0.05 s later). "Fast" = quickest buttons,
  but the game pauses more often on an uneven connection. In the same house both are equally fast.
- Digimon Rumble Arena 2 already runs at 60 fps on the PS2, so no 60 fps patch is needed.

------------------------------------------------------------------
CONTROLLERS LAYOUT (which "PS2 controller ports" the players use)
------------------------------------------------------------------
- "Multitap in port 2": player 1 in port 1, players 2-4 on a multitap in port 2.
  Digimon Rumble Arena 2 needs this. (Digimon: EVERY player presses START on the title screen.)
- "Multitap in port 1": players 1-4 on a multitap in port 1. Many 3-4 player games want this.
- "2 players, no multitap": player 1 in port 1, player 2 in port 2. For 2-player games.
If the other players do not appear in the game (only player 1 can play), the game wants another layout:
close it on all PCs and try the next layout.

------------------------------------------------------------------
OTHER GAMES
------------------------------------------------------------------
Any PS2 game with local multiplayer can be tried. Every new game is an experiment:
- First find the layout that works (see above).
- The screen shows "OUT OF SYNC" if the PCs stop showing the same game. That game then does not work with
  this package (yet); please send the "logs" folder.
- Only normal controllers (DualShock 2). No guitars, light guns, USB devices, EyeToy. At most 4 players.

------------------------------------------------------------------
RULES SO THE PCs STAY THE SAME
------------------------------------------------------------------
- Everyone uses this same package (same package-id.txt), the same game file and the same BIOS file.
- Do not change emulator settings (graphics, speed hacks) in "Controller settings"; only the controls.
- Save states and Reset are switched off during an online game.
- The memory card (emulator\memcards\Mcd001.ps2) must be the same on all PCs. If the game says
  "Different memory card": close the game on ALL PCs, move emulator\memcards\Mcd001.ps2 away on ALL PCs
  (for example to the Desktop), start again (the game makes a new card, the same on every PC).
  Saves of every game are on this one card.
- If the screen says "OUT OF SYNC": close and start again, and send the "logs" folder.

------------------------------------------------------------------
IF IT DOES NOT CONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------------
- Try the reply code (FRIEND step 3).
- Check the firewall (both boxes ticked, see FIRST TIME step 4).
- Mobile internet / hotspots can block direct connections. Backup: install Radmin VPN (free) on both PCs,
  join the same Radmin network, and use "Join by IP" with the host's Radmin address (26.x.x.x).
- The "logs" folder has a connection file and a game file for every session.
